name: share-buttons
title: Share buttons
about:
Adds share links for LinkedIn, X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Bluesky and email to posts and pages, as a theme partial and a share_buttons section. The links are plain links: no JavaScript, no tracking and no share counts.
In the plugin's Settings tab, set Networks as a comma-separated list of ids in display order, for example bluesky, x, email. Choose a Style: icons, labels or both. Set Site URL to your public origin (scheme and no path), because the section needs it. In a post or page template, add {{template "plugin/share_buttons/links" .}}. Grant the plugin settings under Plugins, then Permissions.
Limits: no share counts, no Web Share API and no follow buttons. The theme must call the partial, and the default theme does not. Labels are English only.
